mechanism_narrative: A declining federal funds rate trend compresses discount rates for equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without requiring specific threshold conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where FEDFUNDS has declined over the prior 3 months, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 7.0% for two consecutive months, it signals a deteriorating labor market that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where UNRATE has exceeded 7.0% for two consecutive months, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates robust consumer demand, which supports corporate revenue growth and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where both HOUST and RSAFS have increased by at least 0.5% month-over-month, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of manufacturing supply chain disruption (indicated by INDPRO below 95.0), production constraints reduce corporate profitability and lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where INDPRO is below 95.0, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rising trend in housing starts (HOUST) indicates strong residential construction activity, which correlates with broader economic expansion and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days without requiring specific threshold conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where HOUST has increased over the prior 3 months, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year CPI inflation rate exceeds 3.5%, it signals persistent inflation that may trigger aggressive monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where CPIAUCSL YoY exceeds 3.5%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in employment (PAYEMS) and decline in unemployment (UNRATE) indicates a strong labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where PAYEMS has increased and UNRATE has decreased by at least 0.2 percentage points month-over-month, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of manufacturing slowdown (indicated by INDPRO below 95.0 and declining for two consecutive months), reduced industrial output lowers corporate revenue growth expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where INDPRO is below 95.0 and has declined for two consecutive months, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
